en.headline: Transport Department urges Kai Tak concertgoers to use railway and avoid illegal hire cars
en.dek: Officials reminded spectators at the coming Kai Tak Stadium shows to plan their departure by MTR and warned that illegal cross-boundary hire cars may lack valid insurance.
body: The Transport Department has urged concertgoers at Kai Tak Stadium to take the railway during dispersal and to avoid illegal cross-boundary hire cars.

The advice applies to shows scheduled from 13 to 15 November and on 17 November. The MTR will shorten headways on the Tuen Ma Line, and special bus routes will operate from the Sung Wong Toi Road pick-up area. Cross-boundary coaches will also run, but tickets must be bought online in advance.

Passengers returning to the Mainland on the same evening should note that the last connecting train to Lo Wu leaves Sung Wong Toi at 10.59pm and Kai Tak at 11.01pm. Officials warned that third-party insurance on illegal hire cars may be invalid after an accident.

Spectators were advised to check real-time information on the Easy Leave platform and the HKeMobility app, and to confirm any hire car has a valid permit through the Transport Department's online system.

zh.headline: 運輸署呼籲啟德演唱會觀眾乘搭鐵路 避免乘坐非法過境出租車
zh.dek: 運輸署提醒即將在啟德主場館舉行的演唱會觀眾，散場時應乘搭港鐵，並警告非法過境出租車的第三者保險可能無效。
body: 運輸署呼籲啟德主場館演唱會的觀眾在散場時乘搭鐵路，並避免使用非法過境出租車。
有關建議適用於11月13日至15日及17日的演出。港鐵將縮短屯馬綫列車班次，專營巴士公司會在宋皇臺道上落客區開設11條特別路線。過境長途巴士亦會提供服務，但乘客須預先在網上購票。
計劃當晚返回內地的觀眾應注意，最後一班可轉乘東鐵綫前往羅湖的列車，於宋皇臺站開出時間為晚上10時59分，啟德站為晚上11時01分。署方警告，非法出租車的第三者責任保險在意外中可能無效。
觀眾可留意「易離」平台及HKeMobility應用程式的即時資訊，並透過運輸署網上系統核實出租車是否持有有效許可證。
